response.what_it_is: Brother industrial lockstitch sewing machine with table and servo motor
hidden_risks: motor functionality and longevity under heavy load
internal hook timing and gear wear
table stability and electrical wiring safety
response.best_proof: A short video showing the servo motor running smoothly and the machine stitching fabric without skipping stitches.
seller_claims_unsupported: motor and new legs upgrade quality and operational durability
response.failure_mode: Assuming the machine is fully operational and newly serviced just because the exterior and table look clean.
